title: Entitled Woman Refuses to Get Out of Car - Gets Tased During Traffic Stop!
description:
On July 13th, 2024, officers in Ohio were patrolling a neighborhood when they observed a black Hyundai Santa Fe driving without headlights. Running the vehicle’s plate, they found the registered driver had active felony warrants. Officers initiated a traffic stop and approached the car, but the driver refused to cooperate with officers. Despite multiple requests, the suspect would not provide identification or roll down the windows, instead reaching into their shirt and waistband, ignoring officers' commands to stop.

The situation escalated as officers continued to command the suspect to exit the vehicle, but she refused. When warned that the window would be broken if they did not comply, the suspect threatened to flee. As additional units arrived on the scene, officers were compelled to use force to remove the suspect from the vehicle. A subsequent search revealed a digital scale with residue in the suspect's pocket and a plastic straw with residue inside their wallet.

The suspect was evaluated by EMS on the scene and medically cleared. Following the incident, the suspect was given citations for the headlight violation. The suspect was charged with Resisting Arrest, Obstructing Official Business, and Possession of Drug Paraphernalia.
